text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — prepping Cartella QBR. onboarding slipped ~3 weeks, they27re still on a dev API key, and saw an unexpected token spike Friday night. need a 1-page runbook: 30/60/90 forecast, quick mitigations (low-lift), and a token econ slide. cc @dylan_finops @alex_se

dylan_finops: on it. can someone pull last 30d burn + 30/60/90 projection (baseline + burst)? i27ll draft pricing options: safety-net credits vs monthly retainer.

noah_data: pulling now. quick numbers: 30d tokens = 1,240,500; avg tokens/req = 210; median reqs/day = 5. peak day = 420,300 (embedding batch job). baseline forecast (30/60/90) = 1.5M / 1.9M / 2.3M. burst/no-guardrail = 3.8M in 30d. will drop CSV to drive.

jenna_csm: onboarding update: SSO still pending (blocked on IdP cert), currently on dev key. integration finish ETA Apr 5. renewal in ~45 days. customer asked for monthly predictability and zero surprise bills.

alex_se: quick mitigations i suggest: 1) enforce dev-key read-only and rotate to prod key at go-live, 2) set quota alerts at 70% of committed, 3) enable prefix caching for embeddings and small batch defaults, 4) send a safe default client config patch. example client tweak: {"embeddings_batch_size": 16, "cache_ttl": 3600} (we can paste as inline code in the note).

maria_cs: dylan — can you do a one-slide token econ calc with 2 commercial paths: (A) prepaid credits safety-net + 10% buffer, (B) monthly commit w/ discounted unit price + limited auto-burst. include estimated $ impact at baseline and burst.

dylan_finops: sketching: baseline 1.5M tokens -> ~$750/mo at $0.0005 per 1k tokens; burst 3.8M -> ~$1,900. propose $2k prepaid credits as safety-net for month 1. or a retainer: $1.2k/month + lower overage rate. will formalize.

noah_data: uploaded spreadsheet to drive (link: https://drive.internal/cartella-burn). sheet includes daily burn, top endpoints. top offender = /embed/bulk, avg 40k tokens/job.

jenna_csm: client feedback to capture: nervous about dev key, confused about embed batching behavior, wants a transparent quota dashboard and a predictable billing cadence. i27ll own the customer note.

budgetbot: Alert created: cartella-credits-threshold @70% (subscriber: customer-success).

opsbot: Suggested policy: temporary rate-limit policy for dev key: max 10 reqs/min, daily token cap 250,000 until SSO+prod key. i can push.

alex_se: PR drafted with policy + tests: https://git.internal/r/redwood/policies/1259. example CLI to apply: redwoodctl set-policy --key cartella-dev --rate 10/m --daily-tokens 250000. rollback plan included in PR.

maria_cs: deliverables/timeline (EOD): noah -> final forecast CSV; dylan -> slide + two pricing options; alex -> PR for config rule + rollback; jenna -> customer note draft. we27ll sync 09:00 tomorrow to finalize QBR agenda.

dylan_finops: i27ll include sensitivity analysis showing cost delta when embed batch size changes from 64->16 and wording for renewal conversation (commit vs flexibility).

jenna_csm: adding customer-facing bullet points: 1) baseline forecast and worst-case burst, 2) recommended mitigations (quota+cache+batch), 3) commercial options (prepaid credits or retainer), 4) how to request emergency top-up via billing UI.

maria_cs: product ask: low-friction one-click "temporary credits top-up" for CS/Billing to propose on calls. will file an RFC with product after tumble. :thumbsup:

noah_data: final forecast uploaded. numbers confirmed: conservative baseline 1.5M, operational buffer 2.1M, burst 3.8M. CSV link: https://drive.internal/cartella-burn/forecast.csv

alex_se: unit tests in PR validate policy enforcement and metric emission. will monitor for false positives.

budgetbot: Reminder scheduled: QBR-draft-review 2024-04-02T16:00:00Z (created by maria_cs).

maria_cs: thanks all. will compile materials and share with customer 24h before meeting. short call agenda: 1) show baseline + burst, 2) present mitigations and timeline to prod key, 3) present two commercial options, 4) agree on guardrails and top-up path.

jenna_csm: copying actions into customer note now. ping me if you need wording.

maria_cs: closing thread 1: we27ll review tomorrow at sync. :wave:
